ubo-lite.title: uBlock Origin Lite
ubo-lite.markdown: Note that uBO Lite version does NOT work nearly as well as the full version of uBO. We highly recommend using a browser like Firefox or Brave that allows the full version.

hagezi.title: hagezi
hagezi.markdown: Note that Hagezi does have a Anti-Piracy Blocklist, but it is totally optional, and is [disabled by default](https://i.ibb.co/mrpsX6KK/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/EXTbohV.png) in all of their blocklist versions.

anyrun-note.title: ANY.RUN Note
anyrun-note.markdown: You can use the throwaway .edu sites to sign up + select "other" as profession.

malware-removal-forums.title: Malware Removal Forums
malware-removal-forums.markdown: Note that many of these will suggest removing pirated software, but if you got everything from trusted sources, there is no real need to do that.

general-tweak-warning.title: General Tweak Warning
general-tweak-warning.markdown: Make sure you know what you're doing before you apply these tweaks. Always research first, never just "Apply All" without knowing what what will happen.

alt-warp-clients.title: Alternative Warp Clients
alt-warp-clients.markdown:
If you can't connect, try `Scanner Settings` -> `Endpoint` -> `Suggested` -> then try different IP's to find one that works

* https://github.com/bepass-org/oblivion-desktop
* https://github.com/bepass-org/oblivion

proton-torrenting.title: Proton Torrenting
proton-torrenting.markdown:
Torrenting on Proton VPN's free plan is only possible when using an OpenVPN configuration / [Guide](https://protonvpn.com/support/vpn-config-download). Note that they do expire, so you'll have to make new ones occasionally.

OpenVPN login credentials are located [here](https://account.protonvpn.com/account-password).

google-translate-note.title: Google Translate Note
google-translate-note.markdown: Google Translate can be used as a web proxy. Simply paste your URL into the translate field and then click on the result and view the page in the original language. This way you can navigate any web-page via google.com. Google is almost never blocked so this trick works on most occasions.

chatgpt-limits.title: ChatGPT Limits
chatgpt-limits.markdown: GPT Instant (no reasoning; 16K context) / 10 messages every 5 hours, then GPT-5-mini.

better-reasoning.title: Better Reasoning
better-reasoning.markdown: To get better reasoning, switch to "Think Deeper" mode.

ish.title: ISH Note
ish.markdown:
500K tokens/day

Ad refill:
Each ad will now give 100K tokens.
You can watch up to 5 ads per day, giving you up to 500K extra tokens/day.

modelscope.title: ModelScope Note
modelscope.markdown: This site uses credits (called *magicubes*) to generate images and videos, you get 100 daily. It costs 2 magicubes per image for Qwen, 1 for Z-Image, and 28 for Wan 2.2 14b I2V. You can link an Alibaba Cloud account for free if you ignore the final part of account setup where it asks for payment info and link the account anyways, which gets you 50 extra magicubes daily.

hugging-face-warning.title: Hugging Face Warning
hugging-face-warning.markdown:
HuggingFace uses a system called ZeroGPU to manage access to their high-end GPUs. To make sure that their GPUs don't get fully used up, there are limits on how long you can use the GPU on Spaces like this one.

The rate limit is 120 seconds per day for non-logged in users. You can get around the limit by changing your IP address using a [proxy](https://fmhy.net/privacy#proxy) or [VPN](https://fmhy.net/privacy#vpn) while logged out. If you sign up for a free account, you get a much higher 300 second daily limit, but changing your IP address won't reset it.

mvsep-note.title: MVSEP Note
mvsep-note.markdown: Register to get .wav and .flac output, and lower queue times.

mobilism-ranks.title: Mobilism Ranks
mobilism-ranks.markdown: See what the different Mobilism Ranks mean [here](https://i.imgur.com/WpShSFp.png).

captcha-4pda.title: Captcha 4PDA
captcha-4pda.markdown: Use Google Gemini to translate the captcha.

liteapk-modyolo-note.title: LiteAPK + Modyolo Note
liteapk-modyolo-note.markdown: The site is safe, but they are known for mislabeling things like RockMods releases as their own, and mislabeling versions to make it look like they have newer things than they really do.

aurora-note.title: Aurora Note
aurora-note.markdown: Keep in mind that some apps will not work unless you installed them from the Google Play Store. This is usually true for things like banking, and other institutional apps.

instaeclipse-note.title: InstaEclipse Note
instaeclipse-note.markdown: Use [this guide](https://wispydocs.pages.dev/morphe-piko-obtainium/) to build clean APKs, or use AntiSplit M with ReVanced manager.

yet-another-call-blocker-note.title: Yet Another Call Blocker Note
yet-another-call-blocker-note.markdown: The app itself isn't updated, but the blocklists are. It has a main local blocklist by default, and if you have "Auto-update database" enabled the app receives daily blocklist updates directly from third-party services. More info in their [GitLab repository](https://gitlab.com/xynngh/YetAnotherCallBlocker#yet-another-call-blocker).

applock.title: AppLock Note
applock.markdown: Note this is a privacy utility meant to prevent common snooping, its not claiming to be a security tool, and will not stop forensic analysis.

thunderbird.title: Thunderbird Notifications
thunderbird.markdown:
To get real-time notifications:

Press the three lines in the top left corner -> select the account you want to configure -> select `Manage Folders` -> select the folder you want from below. You can then select inbox and enable push. (Notifications must be enabled).

eruda.title: Eruda
eruda.markdown:
Eruda Console for mobile browsers [bookmarklet](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmarklet):
```
javascript:(function () { var script = document.createElement('script'); script.src="//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/eruda"; document.body.appendChild(script); script.onload = function () { eruda.init() } })();
```

sd-maid.title: SD Maid Note
sd-maid.markdown: The Google Play Store version is paid only. On the F-Droid and GitHub versions, however, you can use paid features for free by pressing `Support the development` and not donating.

android-spotify-note.title: Android Spotify Note
android-spotify-note.markdown: None of Spotify apks (for rooted and non-rooted users) works for now due to server side restriction.

hdo-box-note.title: HDO Box Note
hdo-box-note.markdown: To use the app, HDO Box may ask you to install a third-party video player which contains ads. To block the ads, use the tools linked in [DNS Adblocking](https://fmhy.net/privacy#dns-adblocking).

pangu7.title: Pangu7 Warning
pangu7.markdown:
Do NOT install in a dark location, you will bootloop.

Source: https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-pangu7/?tab=windows

limit-bypass-note.title: Limit Bypass Note
limit-bypass-note.markdown:
- SparseBox: iOS 17.0 - 18.1 Beta 4 (not including 17.7.1, 17.7.2)
- Live container: iOS 16+

redditfilter-note.title: RedditFilter Note
redditfilter-note.markdown: Go to `Settings` -> `Feed Filter` and untoggle `Promoted` to not see ads. You can also untoggle `Recommended` to hide AI suggestions.

spicetify-note.title: Spicetify Note
spicetify-note.markdown:
Join their [Discord](https://discord.gg/VnevqPp2Rr) for version compatibility.

Note that you can use the store built in to get a full list of addons and themes.

strawberry-note.title: Strawberry Note
strawberry-note.markdown: Downloads for Windows & Mac are only availabe on their [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/jonaskvinge) (paid monthly sub required)

google-song-identification.title: Google Song Identification
google-song-identification.markdown: Google and YouTube Music mobile apps have song identification button next to the search box.

reaper-note.title: Reaper Note
reaper-note.markdown: Reaper asks you to buy it after 60 days, but you can just close the popup and keep using it for free.

audiobookbay-warning.title: AudiobookBay Warning
audiobookbay-warning.markdown: Avoid fake download links, use [Torrents / Magnets](https://i.ibb.co/8sV2061/0fa8159b11bb.png), or paste info hash into torrent client.

CodeRabbit.title: CodeRabbit
CodeRabbit.markdown: Note you can get free pro by installing code rabbit on a public github/gitlab repo, as they offer a free open source plan with no popularity requirements or approval/forms.

site-favicon-dl.title: Site Favicon Downloading
site-favicon-dl.markdown: You can also go to `https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=URL&sz=64` where `URL` is the URL of the site you want the favicon of and `sz` is the size in pixels.

neocities.title: Neocities Note
neocities.markdown: Note that free tier has limited file types and can't fetch to external sites.

nekoweb.title: Nekoweb Note
nekoweb.markdown: Bandwidth is generally unlimited, but you might be asked to upgrade to a higher tier if your site consumes a huge amount.

sanet-warning.title: Sanet Warning
sanet-warning.markdown:
Note that Sanet has been known to host unsafe things like KMS Matrix, so it's best to avoid it for software and games.

SoftArchive Mirrors

- https://sanet.download/
- https://softarchive.is/
- https://sanet.lc/
- https://sanet.ws/
- https://sanet.st/
- https://sanet.sb/
- https://soft.ac/

mori-note.title: Māori Note
mori-note.markdown: Māori is the indigenous language of mainland New Zealand. Due to the [Native Schools Act](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C4%81ori_language#Suppression_and_decline) in 1867, children were forbidden to speak it in the classroom, under penalty of corporal punishment, which led to a rapid decline of speakers. There are now [revitalization efforts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C4%81ori_language_revival) (such as Tōku Reo) attempting to promote and reinforce its use.

winrar.title: WinRAR Note
winrar.markdown: WinRAR does not auto-update, and because it had a remote code execution vulnerability in the past, you should make sure you've manually updated **to 7.13 or later** to be safe.

file-converter-note.title: File Converter
file-converter-note.markdown: Do NOT install version 2.2. It is currently broken. If you haven't installed File Converter before, install version 2.1 from [here](https://github.com/Tichau/FileConverter/releases/tag/v2.1). If you've already installed version 2.2, follow the downgrade guide [here](https://github.com/Tichau/FileConverter/issues/728#issuecomment-4077979230).

foxit-warning.title: Foxit Warning
foxit-warning.markdown: The installer tries to install McAfee WebAdvisor + PhantomPDF Business. They can be skipped by clicking "decline" both times.

filezilla-warning.title: FileZilla Warning
filezilla-warning.markdown: The version of FileZilla on FileZilla's front page has adware, but the non-adware version is the only link on FMHY. You can also find the non-adware version by pressing download on the FileZilla front page, then clicking "Show additional download options" under "More download options" at the download page.

buzzheavier-warning.title: Buzzheavier Warning
buzzheavier-warning.markdown: Many popular file hosts have download buttons that redirect to fake malicious download pages. Using the full version of [uBlock Origin](https://www.reddit.com/r/FREEMEDIAHECKYEAH/wiki/adblock-vpn-privacy#wiki_.25BA_adblocking) can prevent this but it doesn't always work. Read this [guide](https://cs.rin.ru/forum/viewtopic.php?f=14&t=159345) to learn what fake malicious download pages look like and how to avoid them. A general rule is to avoid download pages that open in a new tab or redirected page, real downloads happen within the same page as the file host.

filebin-warning.title: Filebin Warning
filebin-warning.markdown: Anyone with a link to a "bin" has full access to it. They can add new files, delete existing files, etc.

filelu-warning.title: Filelu Warning
filelu-warning.markdown: According to their FAQ, you must login to your account at least once every 180 days to prevent your account and it's files being deleted.

oneclick-note.title: OneClick Note
oneclick-note.markdown:
Main features include:
- Download links straight to Google Drive.
- Torrent to Google Drive.
- Google Drive Download Manager (similar to pyLoad).
- Spotify Downloader.
- Jellyfin Support.
- RClone + WebUI.
- And much more.

megabasterd-note.title: Megabasterd Note
megabasterd-note.markdown: Free proxies work but they are very hit and miss.

steam-controller-support.title: Steam Controller Support
steam-controller-support.markdown: Steam has built in support for most controller types, just add your games to Steam, right click the game, and turn on your controller.

glitchwave-note.title: Glitchwave Note
glitchwave-note.markdown:
For charts you can specify months and days using URLs like the following examples:

January 2006:
`https://glitchwave.com/charts/popular/game/2006.01/excl:ratings/`

Jan - Feb 2018:
`https://glitchwave.com/charts/popular/game/2018.01-2018.02/excl:ratings/`

steam-currency-converter-note.title: Steam Currency Converter Note
steam-currency-converter-note.markdown:
For instant currency conversion:

Go to Firefox's add-on settings (or the link `about:addons`) -> click on the add-on -> go to the `Permissions and data` section -> enable the optional sites.

csrin-search.title: CS.RIN Search
csrin-search.markdown: If your initial search doesn't work, trying searching the same term again within the "search these results" engine on the results screen.

freegogpcgames-note.title: FreeGOGPCGames Note
freegogpcgames-note.markdown:
The file checksum may not match with the original GOG installer. This is because many titles on the site are the older versions of the installers, the digital signature on the old installers are signed by *GOG Limited*, which is the old company's name before it was merged with *GOG Sp. z o.o* and all digital file signatures were updated to reflect this name change. The hash does not match the gog-games database because the digital file signatures differ on the installer. Installing either version will produce identical sets of files since the game version remains unchanged.
 
- [/u/AtariRiot66](https://www.reddit.com/r/PiratedGames/comments/1br4m7o/comment/kx8hzz3/)

dodi-warning.title: DODI Warning
dodi-warning.markdown: It is highly recommended to stick to DODI's 1337x page or main website, as sites they linked to have malicious fake download buttons, and shouldn't be used without an [adblocker](https://fmhy.net/privacy#adblocking).

sh-note.title: SH Note
sh-note.markdown: Based on [this](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Secret_Hitler) popular card game which was created by a co-founder of [Cards Against Humanity](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Cards_Against_Humanity).

eaglercraft-note.title: Eaglercraft Note
eaglercraft-note.markdown: Play on Chromium-based browsers for the best performance.

spacewar.title: spacewar
spacewar.markdown: Spacewar! is a [1962 multiplayer game](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Spacewar!) made for the DEC PDP-1 minicomputer. It was later ported to other systems, making it the first ever multi-computer game.

cute-save-button-icon.title: Changing the Cute Save Button Icon
cute-save-button-icon.markdown: You can change the icon of the save button in the extension's settings. The setting is labeled "Your custom cute icon:" You can find standard image download icons to use instead here: https://rentry.co/image-download-icons.

buster-note.title: Buster Note
buster-note.markdown:
The client app simulates user interactions which greatly improves the success rate of buster. You can download the app through the extensions option page, or from the link below: 

https://github.com/dessant/buster-client

The app is available for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

teamspeak-warning.title: TeamSpeak Warning
teamspeak-warning.markdown: Note that TeamSpeak server admins can view user IP addresses, so only join servers you trust.

bypass-freedlink.title: Bypass FREEdlink
bypass-freedlink.markdown: You still need to bypass Cloudflare captcha by yourself. This only bypasses timer on single downloads. You may still need to wait normal time to download another file which is enforced from server-side.

tinyurl-note.title: TinyURL Note
tinyurl-note.markdown:
To reveal the destination URL, replace "www" with "preview" in the URL like so:
 
https://preview.tinyurl.com/5erwtst5

cofi-note.title: Cofi Note
cofi-note.markdown: Useful if you're a coffee enthusiast. The methods are created by James Hoffmann, he's a world champion barista and popular YouTuber.

welib-note.title: WeLib Note
welib-note.markdown: WeLib is *not* connected to Anna's Archive, they simply mirror Anna's content onto their own site that has a different UI. It is not updated as often, and they don't share their codebase improvements publicly, so they aren't endorsed by Anna's themselves.

irc-highway-note.title: IRC Highway Note
irc-highway-note.markdown:
To request a book run: @request [author] [title] - Requests without both [author] and [title] are deleted.
 
To view request status and rules run: @request-list

openasar.title: OpenAsar Note
openasar.markdown: The Vencord installer has an option to install OpenAsar, but you may need to click the install button twice (only once more after clicking "Accept").

bookmarkeddit.title: Bookmarkeddit
bookmarkeddit.markdown: This also extends the amount of saved posts you can view (Reddit caps at 1000 by default).

twitchnosub.title: TwitchNoSub Note
twitchnosub.markdown: Note this is not compatible with Adguard Extra userscript.

driver-note.title: Driver Note
driver-note.markdown: Only install the drivers you actually need. Don't install new drivers all at once, as this could lead to things breaking, especially system audio.

dolby-access-atmos-note.title: Dolby Access / Atmos Note
dolby-access-atmos-note.markdown: Many headsets come with Dolby Access for free without letting users know. You can check if you're licensed by opening Dolby Access, going to settings, and looking in the [bottom right corner](https://i.imgur.com/9vJA6CL.png). It's much better than things like iCue or similar apps.

affine-note.title: AFFiNE Note
affine-note.markdown: Downloads for Windows, Mac, Linux are available on their [GitHub](https://github.com/toeverything/AFFiNE)

1337x-ranks.title: 1337x Ranks
1337x-ranks.markdown:
* ⬛ Black - Administrators
* 🟩 Green - Moderators
* 🟦 Blue - VIP Uploaders (Very Trusted)
* 🟨 Yellow - Uploaders (Trusted)
* 🟥 Red - Trial Uploaders
* ⬜ Grey - Users

mp-opensubs.title: OpenSubtitles with MPC-HC
mp-opensubs.markdown:
You can create an OpenSubtitles account and link it in MPC-HC to bypass quota limits.

You can do this via a panel in MPC-HC located at: `Options` -> `Subtitles` -> `Misc.` > Right-click on `OpenSubtitles.com` -> `Setup` -> Fill in username and password.

tautulli-note.title: Tautulli Note
tautulli-note.markdown: This will sometimes get falsely flagged by Windows Defender and removed automatically, so it may need to be allowed manually.

video-downloadhelper.title: Video DownloadHelper
video-downloadhelper.markdown: Note that some versions of this extension give a watermark on sites that need conversion. It seems to happen on the Windows + Firefox version.

introhd-warning.title: Intro HD Warning
introhd-warning.markdown: Intro HD files are safe, but they do have some fake download buttons on each page. The [real buttons](https://i.ibb.co/NdQHvv12/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/5PTfUor.png) are towards the bottom, and list each file hosts name.

movie-web-sources.title: Adding sources to P-Stream (and all movie-web forks)
movie-web-sources.markdown:
You can enable a extension: [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/p-stream-extension-v1/) / [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/p-stream-enchanced/geimjiobahmbkmaigaafjnoanebpmlmj) / [script](https://github.com/xp-technologies-dev/userscript) that will add more sources, but it needs to connect to all sites to function. The extension is safe, and many people use it, the permissions are just needed in order for the extension to work correctly.

Note that you can run it in a new browser or fresh browser profile if you don't want to use your main browser.

1shows-note.title: 1Shows Note
1shows-note.markdown: Site has AI Upscaled 4K on main 2 server, note this does not work on Firefox or Firefox Based Browser.

flicker-proxy.title: Flicker Proxy
flicker-proxy.markdown: Note that the proxy may be slower, but it can be used in cases where the site or TMDb is blocked.

movieparadise-code.title: MovieParadise Code
movieparadise-code.markdown:
In order to unlock the better host (1fichier) you need a signup code. This is important as without it the site will be only Rapidgator links, which are very slow. You can get a code from the link below, or from the pinned messages in our `#free-stuff` [Discord channel](https://github.com/fmhy/FMHY/wiki/FMHY-Discord).

**[Click Here To Get Code](https://rentry.org/he8fhzku)**

yts-yify-note.title: YTS / Yify Note
yts-yify-note.markdown: YTS / Yify has many fake copycat sites out there, make sure you're on one of the official domains before downloading anything. To be extra protected from fake sites, check out [FMHY SafeGuard](https://github.com/fmhy/FMHY-SafeGuard) and the [FMHY Filterlist](https://github.com/fmhy/FMHYFilterlist).
